Name: RESS
Description: Rhythmic entrainment source separation (Cohen & Gulbinaite, 2017): for each stimulation frequency, add one channel that combines the scalp channels with the weights carrying the most power at that frequency relative to the frequencies beside it, instead of choosing electrodes by where the response looks strongest. Each filter is built from the pooled trials of chosen bins and applied to every trial, so the other bins show what it gives without its flicker. Spectral Measure then reads the component like an electrode (coherence and phase lag to a photodiode, SNR, phase-locking). Needs epoched data with bins
